cards.text: Friend, this story doesn't ease in. No warm-up, no small talk, no stretching. The Philistines fight against Israel, the men of Israel run for it, and many fall dead on Mount Gilboa.

cards.question: The Philistines chase hard after Saul, Israel's king, and his sons. Saul's son Jonathan escapes the battle.

cards.text: The Philistines kill Jonathan and his brothers Abinadab and Malchishua. Then the battle closes in on Saul, and the archers catch up to him and wound him.

cards.question: Saul is wounded and the Philistines are coming. He turns to his armor-bearer. What does Saul ask him to do?

answers.text: Run him through with his sword
Carry him down off the mountain
Hold off the archers for him

cards.question: Saul wants his armor-bearer to run him through. What reason does Saul give?

answers.text: So the Philistines can't torture him
So no one can call him a coward
So he won't be taken back to Philistia

cards.question: Saul's armor-bearer does what Saul asks him to do.

cards.text: The armor-bearer is terrified, and he refuses. So Saul takes his own sword and falls on it.

cards.question: The armor-bearer wouldn't strike Saul. Now he sees that Saul is dead. What does the armor-bearer do?

answers.text: He falls on his own sword too
He carries Saul's body off the mountain
He runs to warn Saul's household

cards.text: So Saul dies together with his three sons and all his house. That's heavy, friend. Let it sit for a second.

cards.question: The Israelites in the valley see that the army has fled and that Saul and his sons are dead. What do they do?

answers.text: They abandon their cities and run
They gather to fight the Philistines
They send to Judah for help

cards.question: The Israelites run from their cities, and the Philistines come and ___ them.

cards.text: The next day the Philistines come back to strip the dead, and on Mount Gilboa they find Saul and his sons. They strip Saul, cut off his head and take his armor.

cards.question: The Philistines keep the news about Saul to themselves.
The Philistines put Saul's armor in the temple of their gods. Where do they hang Saul's head?

cards.text: Word travels to the town of Jabesh-gilead. Its people hear everything the Philistines did to Saul.

cards.question: The people of Jabesh-gilead have heard what happened to Saul. What do all their men of valor do?

answers.text: They bring back the bodies of Saul and his sons
They attack the temple of the Philistine gods
They send gifts to buy back the bodies

cards.text: They carry them to Jabesh and bury their bones under the oak. Some folks won't even answer a group chat. These men go get their king and bring him HOME.

cards.question: After burying Saul and his sons, the men of Jabesh fast for ___ days.

cards.text: Now Chronicles stops the story and tells us plainly why Saul died. I spent years in a junk drawer wondering why things happen. This book just TELLS you.

cards.question: Chronicles gives the reason Saul died. What was it?
Saul didn't keep the word of the LORD, and he even consulted a medium for guidance.

cards.text: And Saul failed to inquire of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death.

cards.question: Saul and all his house are gone. Who does the LORD turn the kingdom over to?

findings.problem: The setup line 'Saul and all his house are gone' rules out the wrong answer 'Esh-baal son of Saul'. Esh-baal is part of Saul's house, and 10:6 already said all his house died, so the baker can eliminate that answer from the setup alone. Rewrite the setup without that line, or swap Esh-baal for a wrong answer the setup doesn't exclude.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

findings.problem: 'These men go get their king and bring him HOME' calls Jabesh Saul's home. The text only says the men retrieved the bodies 'and brought them to Jabesh' (10:12). It never calls Jabesh Saul's home. Keep the group chat joke, but say where they bring him in the text's terms, like 'bring him back to Jabesh'.

rule.text: Call things what the text calls them.
